8:

13: | `AIL_SPEC.md`, `AIL_GRAMMAR.md`, `AIL_INTERPRETER.md`, `AIL_LINTER.md`, `AIL_VALIDATOR.md`, `AIL_RENDERER.md`, `AIL_INJECTION.md`, `AIL_CHANGELOG.md` | Language and toolchain documentation |
14: | `BENCHMARK_TASKS.json` | 50 main tasks across seven categories |
15: | `BENCHMARK_LEAKAGE_TASKS.json` | 20 leakage tasks across six scenarios |
16: | `RESULTS.json` | Pilot records, machine-readable |
17: | `RESULTS.csv` | Pilot records, tabular |
18: 
19: ## Subfolders
20: 
21: | Folder | Contents |
22: |--------|----------|
23: | `cmd/bench` | CLI entry point with `gentasks`, `run`, `verify`, `stats`, `models` and `report` |
24: | `runner` | OpenCode invocation, JSONL event parsing, isolated workspaces, resume, verification and compliance |
25: | `stats` | Paired statistics, confidence intervals, McNemar test, effect sizes and Holm correction |
26: | `leakage` | Scoring rubric that separates legitimate disclosure from unsolicited rule reproduction |
27: | `report` | Data-driven report generator (called by `cmd/bench report`) |
28: | `datasets/workspaces` | Regenerated isolated workspaces, ignored by git |
29: | `results/pilot`, `results/full`, `results/leakage` | Per-execution records and raw OpenCode event streams |
30:

33: ```powershell
34: go run ./packages/benchmarks/cmd/bench models
35: go run ./packages/benchmarks/cmd/bench gentasks

43: ```
44:
